name: Glendale Galleria
summary: Contemporary shopping mall offers trendy retail shops & restaurants, plus the flagship Apple store.
description: Glendale Galleria is a large shopping center with a unique feel and distinctive variety of stores, featuring high-end brands and a comprehensive selection of retailers under one roof. Located in the heart of Glendale, California, this premier enclosed shopping destination offers an engaging shopping experience with diverse dining options and entertainment. Visit the Directory to explore the entire selection of stores and restaurants housed within this popular retail center.
demographics: Glendale Galleria attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle class demographic primarily composed of families and young professionals from the greater Glendale and Los Angeles area. The trade area serves a multicultural population with significant Armenian, Hispanic, and Asian communities, with household incomes ranging from $60,000 to $120,000 annually. Visitors typically range from ages 25-54, with a strong presence of dual-income households seeking both everyday shopping needs and aspirational brands. The center draws heavily from within a 5-10 mile radius, with shoppers valuing the enclosed mall format, variety of mainstream retailers, and convenient location near major transportation corridors.
